Chandler pickups, from Ocotillo to Historic Downtown

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Chandler splits neatly in two for us: the tech corridor in West Chandler around Ocotillo and the Price Corridor campuses, which books corporate and airport work on weekdays, and Historic Downtown and the south — Sun Lakes, Fulton Ranch, Chandler Heights — which books tours, celebrations and weekend groups.

How we work in Chandler

Chandler is where a mid-size vehicle earns its place. Groups here are usually eight to thirteen people heading out together — a team dinner in Historic Downtown, a brewery or wine run, a milestone birthday — and they want one vehicle that waits rather than a convoy that splits up at the first stop.

Where we pick up in Chandler

We pick up across West Chandler around Ocotillo and the Price Corridor, Central Chandler near Historic Downtown, and South Chandler through Sun Lakes, Riggs Road, Fulton Ranch, Andersen Springs and Clemente Ranch. Sky Harbor and Phoenix-Mesa Gateway are both in normal range.

What a booking costs in Chandler

The fleet seats 6 to 56. Below are the Sprinters first, then the group end, each with the rate, the minimum, what that minimum comes to and the per-person figure the pricing page publishes for the same vehicle, on the same basis. The full grid is on the pricing page, and it is the same grid in Chandler as everywhere else we serve.

An hourly charter carries a 4-hour minimum on every listed vehicle, and a 5-hour minimum on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A point-to-point transfer has no hourly minimum at all: it is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and a longer transfer is priced from the drive with the empty return included, with the basis shown on the quote.

What you pay at checkout depends on the method you choose. Some methods take a 50% deposit and charge the balance to that same method no earlier than 48 hours before pickup; others settle in full at checkout and leave nothing due before the ride. Checkout says which applies to yours before you confirm.

Cancellation is decided by the date first. An ordinary date refunds in full 14 or more days ahead; a reservation of 20 or more passengers or 2 or more vehicles refunds in full 30 or more days ahead, with the deposit kept from there in to 14 days; and a major-event date overrides both — its deposit is not refundable and the balance returns only 60 or more days ahead.

Added at the end: 8% Arizona tax, and nothing else — no booking fee and no fuel fee. A promotion code is capped at 10%. Gratuity is optional and is never added for you. Taking the return leg together with the outbound takes 20% off the return leg. An added stop is $50 on a transfer or a round trip and is complimentary on an hourly charter.

Frequently asked questions

Do you do weekday corporate runs in West Chandler?

Yes. The Ocotillo and Price Corridor campuses are regular weekday work — airport transfers, client pickups and team dinners, booked by the hour so the vehicle waits rather than leaving and coming back.

Can you run a brewery or wine tour out of Chandler?

Yes. You book the vehicle for the hours you need and set the stops, or pick one of the ready-made packages on this page, each priced from the vehicle’s published hourly rate. Passengers 21 and over may drink on board in a vehicle for hire, and the chauffeur never does.

Which parts of Chandler do you serve?

All of it — West Chandler and Ocotillo, Central Chandler and Historic Downtown, and South Chandler including Sun Lakes, Fulton Ranch and Chandler Heights.

What size group fits best from Chandler?

Most Chandler bookings are eight to thirteen people, which fits a limo Sprinter comfortably. Larger groups move to a party bus and smaller ones to the Luxury SUV (Suburban) — the reservations team sizes it against your headcount before you pay.
